title: The Derby Cafe job and the 1933 World's Fair
summary: He works at the Derby Cafe with Zutty Singleton and others through the summer of the Fair.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: And Chicago was all right. I knew these people that were supposed to be so-called gangsters. So I went down to

22nd and Ceimac Road, right across from Big Jim Colisimo's and got a job at a place called the Derby Cafe. And I worked at the Derby Cafe and I had Zutty and another guy who played the drums named Freddy Bryant and people like that working with me there. So I stayed in Chicago through the summer with the Fair. And when the Fair was over...
